reason: L4: provider-backed cost estimates. Changes the shared cost function and rate resolution (model_pricing.py), OpenRouter billed cost on usage and catalog/endpoint prices on ProviderConfig (providers.py, model_catalog.py), a defaulted cost_usd on ChatTokenUsage summed where cache counts are (chat.py turn and recovery sums, context.py, orchestration.py), and the cost call sites (context compaction and its cost budget, mission analysis and tool specialists in orchestration.py/agent_tooling.py, mission context spend). Selected: the new cost tests; model_pricing; mission/orchestration/specialist suites that exercise every cost path and budget; context compaction; provider adapter, profile and verification tests (ProviderConfig, route parsing, usage parsing); prompt-cache and chat usage accumulation; the ChatTokenUsage.model_validate(response.usage) consumers (execution AI, writing AI, goals). Counts from pytest --collect-only.

Real OpenRouter evidence (Claude Haiku 4.5 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash cost vs OpenRouter's billed cost, and a scratch-Core compaction) is in the PR body. No full suite.
